decisions.reason: As a flagship electric line that builds directly on the firm's heating and system-integration knowledge and fits its lower-carbon direction, it is more likely to be improved through in-house R&D than withdrawn.

The halogen infrared heater remains close enough to the firm's established expertise for continued learning and adaptation, but its less central strategic role leaves it somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning than the main focus lines.
This industrial electric hall-heater range serves the firm's core non-residential applications, so accumulated field feedback can be absorbed and used to refine the line rather than exit it.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared heater is strongly aligned with the firm's hydrogen-ready trajectory and existing combustion and radiant-heating capabilities, making continued commercialization highly likely.
